objective: Implement the store-backed batch read path used by the endpoint (get_profiles(ids) -> list of rows or None), with unit tests against the frozen store
non_goals: No schema changes to the profile store
No caching inside the store module (T02 owns the cache layer)
implementation_constraints: Existing get_profile behavior must stay byte-identical for single-id reads

acceptance_tests.description: get_profiles([p-1, p-2, p-x]) returns rows for known ids and None for p-x, in input order
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_store.py::test_batch_read asserts order and null for p-x

handoff.notes: record the exact get_profiles signature in verified_facts
